purpose: Replay representative tidal-shape gates with eight lens-geometry starts, including the best two-start cross-domain setting, the best complete-root lensing setting, an attractive missing-root setting, and endpoints from each directional invariant.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the tidal-shape bridge fit.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing.
Only pseudo-elliptical geometry, shear, center, and source positions are fitted to raw training images.
Candidates with missing held-out roots remain failures even when RMS over surviving roots is small.
The replay was selected after viewing two-start results and is a numerical robustness test, not an independent holdout.
SPARC uses an axisymmetric midplane tidal closure while the spherical lensing calculation uses a spherical closure; apparent channel separation may therefore reflect the approximations.
